description: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of parameter updates across layers for different fine-tuning strategies. The horizontal axis displays the categories “Uniform”, “Decreasing”, “Spindle”, and “Bottleneck”, arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “Parameter Updates”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 12, with tick marks at intervals of 2. Each category has a set of 6 bars, all colored light green, representing the parameter updates for each layer. Within each category, the bar heights vary; for example, in the “Uniform” category, the bars range in height from approximately 2 to 4, while in the “Decreasing” category, the bars range from approximately 10 to 2. The “Spindle” category shows bars ranging from approximately 1 to 8, and the “Bottleneck” category shows bars ranging from approximately 2 to 6. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation. A legend indicates that the light green color represents “Uniform”, “Decreasing”, “Spindle”, and “Bottleneck” parameter update distributions.
